**In one line**: A report says Anthropic expects to post a profit for a second consecutive quarter.

### Key points
- According to Firstpost, Anthropic is projected to record a profit for a second straight quarter.
- The signal stands out at a time when most frontier AI companies run at a loss under heavy training and infrastructure costs.
- Specific revenue and profit figures were not firmly detailed in the report, so official results would be needed for confirmation.

### Why it matters
The sustainability of the frontier LLM business hinges on when — or whether — these labs turn profitable. If the back-to-back profit outlook holds, it would offer evidence that the massive spending can be monetized, setting a reference point for rivals and investors alike.
